--- <repo>/cmake/modules/AddLLVM.cmake lines 568-586 ---
# add_llvm_library(): every LLVM library gets an install() rule by default. The WIN32 branch only chooses RUNTIME vs LIBRARY.
  568|     set_target_properties( ${name} PROPERTIES EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ON)
  569|   elseif(NOT _is_gtest)
  570|     if (NOT LLVM_INSTALL_TOOLCHAIN_ONLY OR ${name} STREQUAL "LTO")
  571|       if(ARG_SHARED OR BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
  572|         if(WIN32 OR CYGWIN)
  573|           set(install_type RUNTIME)
  574|         else()
  575|           set(install_type LIBRARY)
  576|         endif()
  577|       else()
  578|         set(install_type ARCHIVE)
  579|       endif()
  580| 
  581|       install(TARGETS ${name}
  582|             EXPORT LLVMExports
  583|             ${install_type} DESTINATION lib${LLVM_LIBDIR_SUFFIX}
  584|             COMPONENT ${name})
  585| 
  586|       if (NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)

--- <repo>/cmake/modules/AddLLVM.cmake lines 680-695 ---
# add_llvm_tool(): every LLVM tool is installed unless LLVM_INSTALL_TOOLCHAIN_ONLY, in which case only llvm-ar and llvm-objdump survive - neither of which DXC builds.
  680| 
  681|   list(FIND LLVM_TOOLCHAIN_TOOLS ${name} LLVM_IS_${name}_TOOLCHAIN_TOOL)
  682|   if (LLVM_IS_${name}_TOOLCHAIN_TOOL GREATER -1 OR NOT LLVM_INSTALL_TOOLCHAIN_ONLY)
  683|     if( LLVM_BUILD_TOOLS )
  684|       install(TARGETS ${name}
  685|               EXPORT LLVMExports
  686|               RUNTIME DESTINATION bin
  687|               COMPONENT ${name})
  688| 
  689|       if (NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  690|         add_custom_target(install-${name}
  691|                           DEPENDS ${name}
  692|                           COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
  693|                                   -DCMAKE_INSTALL_COMPONENT=${name}
  694|                                   -P "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmake_install.cmake")
  695|       endif()

--- <repo>/CMakeLists.txt lines 807-825 ---
# DXC's own trimmed install path: LLVM_DISTRIBUTION_COMPONENTS defaults to dxc;dxcompiler;dxc-headers and drives install-distribution. Not platform-guarded.
  807| # HLSL Change begin - Set default distribution value.
  808| set(LLVM_DISTRIBUTION_COMPONENTS "dxc;dxcompiler;dxc-headers" CACHE STRING "")
  809| # HLSL Change end - Set default distribution value.
  810| 
  811| # This must be at the end of the LLVM root CMakeLists file because it must run
  812| # after all targets are created.
  813| if(LLVM_DISTRIBUTION_COMPONENTS)
  814|   # HLSL Change - Deleted restriction for non-IDE builds. This works with Visual
  815|   # Studio for DXC because of the limited number of targets.
  816|   
  817|   add_custom_target(install-distribution)
  818|   foreach(target ${LLVM_DISTRIBUTION_COMPONENTS})
  819|     if(TARGET install-${target})
  820|       add_dependencies(install-distribution install-${target})
  821|     else()
  822|       message(FATAL_ERROR "Specified distribution component '${target}' doesn't have an install target")
  823|     endif()
  824|   endforeach()
  825| endif()

--- <repo>/include/dxc/CMakeLists.txt lines 24-48 ---
# dxc-headers component: an explicit FILES list, so no CMakeLists.txt and no d3dx12.h reach the install tree. WinAdapter.h is added on non-Windows only.
   24|     ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.h
   25|     ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/dxcapi.h

   28| 
   29| if (NOT WIN32)
   30|   set(DXC_PLATFORM_PUBLIC_HEADERS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/WinAdapter.h)
   31| endif()
   32| 
   33| # This target just needs to exist for the distribution build, it doesn't need to
   34| # actually build anything since the headers are static.
   35| add_custom_target(dxc-headers)
   36| 
   37| install(FILES 
   38|     ${DXC_PUBLIC_HEADERS}
   39|     ${DXC_PLATFORM_PUBLIC_HEADERS}
   40|     DESTINATION include/dxc
   41|     COMPONENT dxc-headers
   42|     )
   43| 
   44| add_custom_target(install-dxc-headers

--- <repo>/tools/clang/tools/dxcompiler/CMakeLists.txt lines 155-168 ---
# dxcompiler install destination is platform-conditional: bin/ on Windows, lib/ elsewhere. This is the one place the reporter's Linux layout differs from what was measured here.
  155|   set(install_dest RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
  156| else()
  157|   set(install_dest LIBRARY DESTINATION lib${LLVM_LIBDIR_SUFFIX})
  158| endif()
  159| 
  160| install(TARGETS dxcompiler
  161|   ${install_dest}
  162|   COMPONENT dxcompiler)
  163| 
  164| add_custom_target(install-dxcompiler
  165|   DEPENDS dxcompiler
  166|   COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
  167|           -DCMAKE_INSTALL_COMPONENT=dxcompiler
  168|           -P "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmake_install.cmake")
